panels.title: Work (kcal, kJ)
panels.description: Strava **calories** (kcal) and **kilojoules** (kJ) from the detailed activity API after sync. Parentheses: rounded kJ.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE
  WHEN calories IS NULL AND kilojoules IS NULL THEN '— (—)'
  ELSE concat(
    CASE WHEN calories IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE ROUND(calories::numeric, 0)::text END,
    ' (',
    CASE WHEN kilojoules IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE ROUND(kilojoules::numeric, 0)::text END,
    ')'
  )
END AS "Work"
FROM activities WHERE id = ${activity_id}
SELECT ROUND(weighted_average_watts::numeric, 0) AS "Watts" FROM activities WHERE id = ${activity_id}

SELECT
  (point->>0)::float AS lat,
  (point->>1)::float AS lng
FROM activity_streams,
LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(data->'latlng') AS point
WHERE activity_id = ${activity_id}
  AND data ? 'latlng'

SELECT
  a.start_date + (t.val::float * INTERVAL '1 second') AS time,
  ROUND(e.val::numeric, 1) AS "Elevation"
FROM activity_streams s
JOIN activities a ON a.id = s.activity_id,
LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(s.data->'time') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(val, idx),
LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(s.data->'altitude') WITH ORDINALITY AS e(val, idx2)
WHERE s.activity_id = ${activity_id}
  AND s.data ? 'altitude'
  AND t.idx = e.idx2
ORDER BY t.idx

SELECT
  a.start_date + (t.val::float * INTERVAL '1 second') AS time,
  h.val::int AS "Heart Rate"
FROM activity_streams s
JOIN activities a ON a.id = s.activity_id,
LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(s.data->'time') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(val, idx),
LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(s.data->'heartrate') WITH ORDINALITY AS h(val, idx2)
WHERE s.activity_id = ${activity_id}
  AND s.data ? 'heartrate'
  AND t.idx = h.idx2
ORDER BY t.idx
SELECT ROUND(average_heartrate::numeric, 0) AS "Avg HR" FROM activities WHERE id = ${activity_id}
SELECT ROUND(max_heartrate::numeric, 0) AS "Max HR" FROM activities WHERE id = ${activity_id} AND max_heartrate IS NOT NULL

SELECT
  a.start_date + (t.val::float * INTERVAL '1 second') AS time,
  ROUND(v.val::numeric, 2) AS "Speed"
FROM activity_streams s
JOIN activities a ON a.id = s.activity_id,
LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(s.data->'time') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(val, idx),
LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(s.data->'velocity_smooth') WITH ORDINALITY AS v(val, idx2)
WHERE s.activity_id = ${activity_id}
  AND s.data ? 'velocity_smooth'
  AND t.idx = v.idx2
ORDER BY t.idx
SELECT average_speed * 3.6 AS "Avg Speed" FROM activities WHERE id = ${activity_id} AND average_speed IS NOT NULL

SELECT MAX(v.val::numeric) * 3.6 AS "Max Speed" FROM activity_streams s, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(s.data->'velocity_smooth') AS v(val) WHERE s.activity_id = ${activity_id} AND s.data ? 'velocity_smooth'

SELECT
  a.start_date + (t.val::float * INTERVAL '1 second') AS time,
  p.val::int AS "Power"
FROM activity_streams s
JOIN activities a ON a.id = s.activity_id,
LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(s.data->'time') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(val, idx),
LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(s.data->'watts') WITH ORDINALITY AS p(val, idx2)
WHERE s.activity_id = ${activity_id}
  AND s.data ? 'watts'
  AND t.idx = p.idx2
ORDER BY t.idx
SELECT max_watts AS "Max Power" FROM activities WHERE id = ${activity_id} AND max_watts IS NOT NULL
SELECT ROUND(average_watts::numeric, 0) AS "Avg Power" FROM activities WHERE id = ${activity_id} AND average_watts IS NOT NULL
SELECT ROUND(best_20min_power::numeric, 0) AS "Best 20min" FROM activities WHERE id = ${activity_id} AND best_20min_power IS NOT NULL

SELECT
  a.start_date + (t.val::float * INTERVAL '1 second') AS time,
  c.val::int AS "Cadence"
FROM activity_streams s
JOIN activities a ON a.id = s.activity_id,
LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(s.data->'time') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(val, idx),
LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(s.data->'cadence') WITH ORDINALITY AS c(val, idx2)
WHERE s.activity_id = ${activity_id}
  AND s.data ? 'cadence'
  AND t.idx = c.idx2
ORDER BY t.idx

SELECT ROUND(AVG(c.val::numeric), 0) AS "Avg Cadence" FROM activity_streams s, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(s.data->'cadence') AS c(val) WHERE s.activity_id = ${activity_id} AND s.data ? 'cadence' AND c.val::numeric > 0
SELECT MAX(c.val::int) AS "Max Cadence" FROM activity_streams s, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(s.data->'cadence') AS c(val) WHERE s.activity_id = ${activity_id} AND s.data ? 'cadence'

SELECT
  a.start_date + (t.val::float * INTERVAL '1 second') AS time,
  temp.val::float AS "Temperature"
FROM activity_streams s
JOIN activities a ON a.id = s.activity_id,
LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(s.data->'time') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(val, idx),
LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(s.data->'temp') WITH ORDINALITY AS temp(val, idx2)
WHERE s.activity_id = ${activity_id}
  AND s.data ? 'temp'
  AND t.idx = temp.idx2
ORDER BY t.idx

SELECT
  COALESCE((hr_zone_seconds->>'zone_1')::float, 0) AS "Zone 1",
  COALESCE((hr_zone_seconds->>'zone_2')::float, 0) AS "Zone 2",
  COALESCE((hr_zone_seconds->>'zone_3')::float, 0) AS "Zone 3",
  COALESCE((hr_zone_seconds->>'zone_4')::float, 0) AS "Zone 4",
  COALESCE((hr_zone_seconds->>'zone_5')::float, 0) AS "Zone 5"
FROM activities
WHERE id = ${activity_id}
  AND hr_zone_seconds IS NOT NULL
